label: Discord
description: Chat platform for communities with servers, channels, roles, and bots.
notes: sendChannelMessage: dropped optional multipart file attachments (executor is JSON-only); message therefore promoted to required. createGuildRole: dropped color (API wants integer), hoist and mentionable (API wants booleans) — all optional, omitted per typed-JSON rule; audit-log reason kept as an optional header (Discord tolerates it empty). AP's find_channel and list_guild_members do client-side filtering/reshaping we cannot express, so they are transpiled as plain list operations (listChannels, listGuildMembers); listGuildMembers requires the Server Members privileged intent and limit is made required because Discord defaults to 1. send_message_webhook skipped: live catalog already has discord.sendMessage (webhook-based) of equal fidelity once tts/embeds (typed JSON) are dropped. Standardized on API v10 (piece mixes v9/v10). Path IDs are Discord snowflakes, substituted raw.

nodes.label: Discord: Send Channel Message
nodes.description: Post a message to a Discord channel or thread as a bot.
nodes.search: discord bot message send chat channel thread post notify server

config.label: Channel ID
config.help: Channel or thread ID (enable Developer Mode in Discord to copy IDs)

credentials.help: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal (Applications → Bot); the bot must be a member of the target server with permission to send messages

nodes.label: Discord: Create Channel
nodes.description: Create a new text channel in a Discord server.
nodes.search: discord create channel new server guild text

config.label: Topic
config.help: Optional channel topic; leave blank for none

credentials.help: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal; requires the Manage Channels permission

nodes.label: Discord: Rename Channel
nodes.description: Change the name of an existing Discord channel.
nodes.search: discord rename channel update edit name modify

credentials.help: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal; requires the Manage Channels permission

nodes.label: Discord: List Channels
nodes.description: Fetch all channels in a Discord server.
nodes.search: discord list channels find search guild server lookup

credentials.help: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal; the bot must be a member of the server

nodes.label: Discord: List Members
nodes.description: Fetch members of a Discord server.
nodes.search: discord list members users guild server find search people

config.label: Limit
config.help: Max members to return (1–1000; Discord defaults to 1 if unset)

credentials.help: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal; requires the Server Members privileged intent enabled for the bot

nodes.label: Discord: Add Role to Member
nodes.description: Assign a role to a member of a Discord server.
nodes.search: discord add assign role member user permission grant guild

config.label: Role ID
config.help: Role ID (Server Settings → Roles, or via the roles API)

credentials.help: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal; requires the Manage Roles permission and a bot role above the target role

nodes.label: Discord: Remove Role from Member
nodes.description: Remove a role from a member of a Discord server.
nodes.search: discord remove revoke role member user permission guild

credentials.help: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal; requires the Manage Roles permission and a bot role above the target role

nodes.label: Discord: Create Role
nodes.description: Create a new role in a Discord server.
nodes.search: discord create role new guild server permission

config.label: Audit Log Reason
config.help: Optional reason recorded in the server's audit log

credentials.help: Bot token from the Discord Developer Portal; requires the Manage Roles permission
